acip: MA GRUB NA, SPYI CHOS CAN, KHYOD RTAG PA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD RTAG PA YIN, KHYOD RTAG PA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING RTAG PA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, spyi chos can, khyod rtag pa'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod rtag pa yin, khyod rtag pa dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing rtag pa yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that qualities are characteristic of unchanging things. Suppose you do disagree.  Let's consider then qualities. They are so characteristic of unchanging things, Because (1) they are unchanging; (2) they are related to unchanging things in such a way that to be a quality is to be unchanging; and (3) there are many things which are not qualities but which are still unchanging things.
